title: RemoteDescriptor payload
description: Output of the PRD §40.7 `discover(cursor, since)` boundary: one candidate document located at the source, before anything is fetched.

descriptor_key.description: Adapter-assigned stable key for this descriptor within the source.

document_hint.description: Free-text adapter hint about what the descriptor is likely to be. Never authoritative; identity is decided by `identify()`.

cursor.description: Opaque resumption cursor for the next `discover()` call.
